## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and relevant specification or TODO item.

## Validation

Give commands and results, including remaining validation limits. For OPCD code,
link evidence appropriate to the affected invariants in docs/TODO.md and docs/HARDWARE.md.

## Merge readiness

- [ ] `Project checks` passes on the latest revision.
- [ ] `Agent reviews completed` passes on the latest revision; findings are resolved or explicitly accepted.
- [ ] Relevant implementation tests pass; GPU/distributed evidence is provided when needed.
- [ ] The user explicitly accepts this PR for merge.

Follow [the reviewer operation policy](../docs/WORKFLOW.md#reviewer-operation) for automatic updates, authorized requests, and retries.
